headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, led by AI‑driven wins, but profit expansion slowed for some peers.
summary: Total sector revenue rose 12% YoY, with TCS and HCLTech posting double‑digit growth and operating margins above 20% and 18% respectively. AI revenue is becoming a material contributor, highlighted by TCS (>$3 bn) and HCLTech (78% YoY jump). Mid‑tier players such as Infosys trimmed guidance as growth slowed, while Coforge delivered the strongest top‑line surge at 53% YoY. Attrition remained high across the larger firms, hovering around 13‑14%.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: AI‑related revenue and large‑deal wins lifted margins for TCS, HCLTech and LTM.

themes.title: Margin divergence
themes.detail: Top‑line growth outpaced profit growth at Infosys and Wipro, whereas Coforge improved EBIT guidance.

themes.title: Talent attrition pressure
themes.detail: Headcount attrition stayed above 13% at TCS and Wipro, indicating talent market tightness.
